description: Describing the operational aspects of systems, processes, or activities, including their components, conditions, effects, and their placement or involvement within various structured environments

The precise specification of attributes, relationships, actions, and the temporal, spatial, or conditional context of entities and events, including their characteristics, states, and any associated negations or limitations
An entity's existence, qualities, location, or temporal setting, as well as actions, events, and processes, including their capabilities and negations

The creation, fabrication, or composition of objects and notions, their defining characteristics, properties, and current condition, including preparation and formation processes, personal evaluations or desires related to these outcomes, and instances of absence, choice, or comparison
The presence or absence of a state, condition, or attribute; the initiation, continuation, or termination of an action or process; and any imposed limitation or restriction
Structured frameworks and initiatives influencing individual and collective advancement, skill development, health, and social welfare within various environments
The initiation, progression, and continuous engagement in an action, experience, or a state of development and transformation
Actions and states of being, attributes and characteristics, with their surrounding temporal, spatial, and relational contexts, encompassing notions of negation, comparison, and specificity
Descriptions of actions, processes, and states of being, alongside attributes and contextual relationships, including purpose, time, location, conditions, negation, and emphasis
